questions.question_english: What is the role of the ‘Nodal Teacher for Safety’ in a school?
options_english: To exclusively teach the theoretical disaster management chapter in geography classes to senior secondary students
To act as focal point for safety initiatives, coordinate drills, and liaison with safety committee.
To act as a bodyguard for the Principal
To manage the school budget for structural repairs
questions.explanation_english: To act as focal point for safety initiatives, coordinate drills, and liaison with safety committee. A Nodal Teacher for Safety functions as the primary institutional coordinator for campus risk management, safety programs, and emergency preparedness efforts. The nodal teacher leads safety drills, conducts preliminary hazard assessments, maintains emergency records, and liaises with the School Safety Committee. Dedicated safety coordination ensures consistent implementation of safety frameworks across all school departments.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: सुरक्षा पहलों का समन्वय करना, अभ्यास आयोजित करना और सुरक्षा समिति के साथ संपर्क बनाए रखना। इस उपाय से पहचाने गए जोखिमों को कम करने, आपात स्थिति के लिए तैयारी बढ़ाने और विद्यार्थियों तथा कर्मचारियों की सुरक्षित निकासी/सुरक्षा में मदद मिलती है।

The concept of ‘Safe Touch’ and ‘Unsafe Touch’ (Good Touch/Bad Touch)

questions.question_english: According to standard medical emergency preparedness guidelines, every school must designate at least one staff member as:

questions.explanation_english: A nodal first-aid trained teacher Emergency medical preparedness mandates designating and certifying at least one trained nodal teacher for first-aid duties within every school facility. questions.question_english: Which of the following is a mandatory physical requirement for a school bus as per the safety guidelines?
options_english: Tinted black glasses to protect from sunlight
Windows fitted with horizontal grills
Seating capacity exceeding the registered limit by 20%
Absence of locks on doors to allow easy escape
questions.explanation_english: Windows fitted with horizontal grills School bus safety standards require all side windows to be fitted with horizontal grills and protective mesh. Window grills prevent students from extending head or limbs outside moving vehicles, significantly reducing severe accidental injury risks. Implementing physical window barriers maintains physical passenger safety without obstructing necessary ventilation during daily transportation.
